title: DynamoDB resilience — PITR + Streams + stub stream Lambda
topic: DynamoDB PITR, on-demand backups, Streams view types, Lambda event source mapping, global tables awareness, DynamoDB vs Aurora for GSA wiki counters
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-18-dynamodb-resilience.md and night-18-lab-dynamodb-setup scripts. Answer without peeking at night-18-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: An operator accidentally deletes items from saa-study-gsa-wiki-views. PITR is enabled. What is the correct recovery action?

options.A: Run restore-table-to-point-in-time to a new table name within the 35-day window
options.B: Enable the stream TRIM_HORIZON starting position to replay deleted rows in place
options.C: Call UpdateItem on each missing pageId with ConditionExpression attribute_not_exists
options.D: Disable PITR, run on-demand backup, and import the snapshot over the same table name

questions.question: night-18-lab enables StreamViewType NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES on saa-study-gsa-wiki-views. The stub Lambda logs old and new viewCount on MODIFY. Which view type would hide the previous count?

options.A: OLD_IMAGE only — emits the item before the change but not after
options.B: NEW_IMAGE only — emits the item after the change but not before
options.C: KEYS_ONLY — partition key only with no attribute payload
options.D: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES — includes both images on every event type

questions.question: You create a DynamoDB stream event source mapping with StartingPosition=LATEST. You then run -BumpView on wiki/iceland. An earlier bump from before the mapping never invoked Lambda. Why?

options.A: LATEST delivers only records after the mapping is created — prior stream data is skipped
options.B: PITR must be disabled while stream mappings are active
options.C: On-demand tables cannot emit MODIFY events until provisioned capacity is set
options.D: Lambda polls SQS behind the stream and the queue was empty at mapping time

questions.question: GSA prod wiki-api increments page views with UpdateItem. night-18-lab uses ADD viewCount :inc. Why is ADD preferred over read-then-SET for hot counters?

options.A: ADD requires a transaction and therefore guarantees cross-table consistency
options.B: ADD only works on sort keys, preventing hot partition mistakes
options.C: ADD atomically increments without a separate GetItem — avoids lost updates under concurrent writers
options.D: ADD triggers Kinesis Data Streams automatically for analytics export

questions.question: A stream processor Lambda fails mid-batch. DynamoDB stream event source mappings retry. What design property keeps audit logging safe?

options.A: Write the same log line twice is acceptable — handler only prints idempotent summaries
options.B: Set batch size to 1 and disable retries on the mapping
options.C: Use FIFO SQS between the stream and Lambda for exactly-once delivery
options.D: Switch StreamViewType to KEYS_ONLY so retries carry no duplicate payload

questions.question: Compare tonight's stub stream Lambda to Night 17 saa-study-gsa-stats-uploader. What is the trigger difference?

options.A: Both use EventBridge schedules firing every minute
options.B: Night 18 uses Aurora logical replication slots; Night 17 uses DynamoDB Streams
options.C: Night 18 reacts to DynamoDB row changes; Night 17 polls SQS completion messages
options.D: Both use API Gateway HTTP API synchronous invoke paths

questions.question: Global Ski Atlas needs wiki read/write in us-east-1 and eu-west-1 with local low latency. Tables are DynamoDB. Which feature fits?

options.A: DynamoDB global tables with multi-Region active-active replication
options.B: Aurora Global Database for WikiPages items stored as JSON rows
options.C: RDS read replica in eu-west-1 attached to the wiki DynamoDB table
options.D: S3 Cross-Region Replication on the DynamoDB table export bucket only

questions.question: A Lambda in Night 9 private subnets calls DynamoDB in the same Region. NAT Gateway charges are high on GetItem traffic. What reduces DynamoDB egress cost?

options.A: Enable DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) in the public subnet
options.B: Move the table to Aurora Serverless v2 in the same VPC
options.C: Attach an internet gateway directly to the private subnet route table
options.D: Add a DynamoDB gateway VPC endpoint and route DynamoDB prefix list traffic locally

questions.question: night-18-lab uses PAY_PER_REQUEST on saa-study-gsa-wiki-views. Wiki traffic spikes unpredictably on powder days. Why match on-demand billing here?

options.A: On-demand removes the need for partition keys on hot counters
options.B: On-demand automatically enables global tables in a second Region
options.C: On-demand scales read/write capacity per request without provisioning RCU/WCU
options.D: On-demand requires PITR to stay disabled to control backup cost

questions.question: You need centralized nightly backups for DynamoDB wiki tables, Aurora resort_stats, and EBS volumes under one retention policy. Which service?

options.A: DynamoDB PITR alone — it backs up all AWS data stores in the account
options.B: CloudTrail with data events on every table stream shard
options.C: RDS automated backup window extended to 35 days for all services
options.D: AWS Backup with a plan that selects resources by tag or ARN (Night 19 topic)

questions.question: Two Regions write the same item key in a global table within the same second. What conflict resolution applies?

options.A: DynamoDB rejects the second write with ConditionalCheckFailedException globally
options.B: The write from the Region with the lower table ARN wins automatically
options.C: Last writer wins per item — eventual consistency across Regions
options.D: Strongly consistent reads block all writes until a global lock expires

questions.question: resort_stats monthly_runs needs SQL JOIN reports. wiki/iceland viewCount needs millions of atomic increments. Where should each live per GSA split?

options.A: Both in Aurora — use JSONB columns for view counters
options.B: Both in DynamoDB — model JOINs as multiple Query calls per report
options.C: Aurora for relational resort_stats; DynamoDB for wiki view counters
options.D: S3 Parquet for both — Athena replaces DynamoDB and Aurora entirely

questions.question: The stream processor IAM role needs dynamodb:GetRecords on the stream ARN. What else must the role allow for Lambda to emit logs?

options.A: ec2:CreateNetworkInterface for DynamoDB Streams ENI attachment
options.B: logs:CreateLogGroup, logs:CreateLogStream, logs:PutLogEvents on CloudWatch Logs
options.C: dynamodb:UpdateItem on the source table for every processed record
options.D: sqs:SendMessage to mirror stream batches into a completion queue

questions.question: Maximum continuous backup window for DynamoDB PITR on a single-Region table is how long?

options.A: 7 days — same as default RDS automated backup retention
options.B: 14 days — matches maximum SQS message retention
options.C: 35 days — exam standard for DynamoDB PITR retention
options.D: 365 days — requires AWS Backup premium tier only

questions.question: night-18-lab teardown deletes saa-study-gsa-wiki-views. Prod WikiPages is untouched. A teammate asks whether teardown affects Night 17 Aurora. What is true?

options.A: Aurora writer endpoint stops when any DynamoDB table in the account is deleted
options.B: Nothing — Night 18 study table and stream Lambda are independent of Night 16/17 Aurora
options.C: Night 17 stats-uploader loses VPC ENI when wiki-views table is removed
options.D: SQS completion queue is deleted automatically with the DynamoDB table
